# @zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox

Tri-state checkbox with WAI-ARIA `role="checkbox"` semantics. Unlike `switch` (a
boolean instant-commit toggle), a checkbox is a selection-state form control that
also supports the INDETERMINATE ("mixed") state -- the building block of a
checkbox group.

WAI-ARIA APG: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/

TRI-STATE MODEL (ADR 0008). ONE 3-valued signal `_state` in
{"true","false","mixed"}. Those three tokens ARE the `aria-checked` values, so
the paint effect writes `aria-checked = _state()` with NO mapping branch. The
derived booleans `checked()` / `indeterminate()` can never disagree with the
painted attribute -- the reason a single signal is used instead of a
boolean-checked + boolean-indeterminate pair (which can be set to the incoherent
checked:true + indeterminate:true combination).

## Quick example

```js
import { createCheckbox } from "@zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox";

const cb = createCheckbox({ defaultChecked: false });
cb.attachRoot(document.querySelector("#agree"));
cb.attachLabel(document.querySelector("#agree-label"));
// Space or click on root/label toggles; aria-checked + data-* paint on the root.
```

## Options

- `defaultChecked?: boolean`        -- initial checked state (default false)
- `defaultIndeterminate?: boolean`  -- seed "mixed" (wins over defaultChecked)
- `disabled?: boolean`              -- initial disabled state
- `required?: boolean`              -- paints aria-required on the root
- `onChange?: (checked, reason) => void`  -- `checked` is a boolean; fires on
                                             every committed state change

Unknown option keys throw TypeError with a did-you-mean hint; null / non-object
are rejected; undefined / no-arg is legal (fail-closed construction).

## API

- `checked()` -> boolean            -- `_state() === "true"`
- `indeterminate()` -> boolean      -- `_state() === "mixed"`
- `disabled()` -> boolean
- `setChecked(checked, reason?)`    -- clears mixed (true -> "true", false -> "false")
- `setIndeterminate(v, reason?)`    -- true -> "mixed"; false resolves "mixed" to
                                       "false" (leaves a non-mixed state untouched)
- `toggle(reason?)`                 -- APG: mixed -> true, false -> true, true -> false
- `setDisabled(bool)`
- `destroy()`                       -- seals owned signals (H-12); reads freeze at
                                       the final value, writes become no-ops
- `destroyed` (getter) -> boolean

## Attachment methods

- `attachRoot(el)`   -- role=checkbox, tabindex, Space/click listeners, ARIA +
                        data-* painting. Paints current state immediately.
- `attachLabel(el)`  -- aria-labelledby auto-wired; clicking the label toggles
                        and focuses the root.
- `attachInput(el)`  -- optional native `<input type="checkbox">` for form
                        submission; kept in sync (checked + indeterminate);
                        its change event drives setChecked.

## CSS contract

Root gets:
- `aria-checked="true|false|mixed"`  -- painted STRAIGHT from `_state`
- `data-checked`                     -- present when checked (`_state` "true")
- `data-indeterminate`               -- present when "mixed"
- `data-disabled`                    -- present when disabled
- `aria-disabled="true"`             -- when disabled
- `aria-required="true"`             -- when required

## Keyboard (per ARIA APG)

- Space: toggle. An indeterminate checkbox becomes CHECKED on the user's toggle.

## Custom element wrapper

`import "@zakkster/lite-headless/checkbox/element"` registers `<lite-checkbox>`.

```html
<lite-checkbox default-checked name="terms">
    <span data-checkbox-root></span>
    <span data-checkbox-label>Accept terms</span>
</lite-checkbox>
```

### Attributes

- `default-checked` / `default-indeterminate` -- seed state
- `checked` / `indeterminate` -- observed + reflected (set/remove to control)
- `disabled` -- observed
- `required`
- `name` -- auto-creates a visually-hidden native input for `<form>` submission
- `value` -- value of that input (default "on")

### Imperative API on host

`host.toggle(reason?)`, `host.setChecked(v, reason?)`,
`host.setIndeterminate(v, reason?)`, `host.setDisabled(v)`; getters
`host.checked`, `host.indeterminate`, `host.disabled`.

### Dispatched events

- `change` -- `{ detail: { checked, indeterminate, reason } }`

## Comparison to switch / radio

- `switch`: boolean on/off, no mixed state, instant-commit toggle semantics.
- `checkbox`: three states (checked / unchecked / mixed), the group building block.
- radio (via `radio-group`): one-of-N selection; a checkbox group is any-of-N.
